description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) Ethernet driver specific to Lantiq chips, implementing core functions for Danube, Amazon-SE, and AR9 platforms. It includes network device setup, interrupt handling, buffer management, and proc filesystem interfaces.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates resources, registers network devices, and sets up interrupt handling.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deregisters devices, and stops the driver.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures network device parameters and NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for a device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts network device operation and enables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops network device operation and disables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by preparing descriptors and signaling hardware.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for MIB and configuration.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout events.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox events, managing RX and TX queues.

methods.name: mailbox_signal
methods.description: Signals other hardware components via mailbox registers.

methods.name: do_ptm_tasklet
methods.description: Deferred processing for mailbox RX events when configured with tasklets.

methods.name: proc_read_version
methods.description: Reads driver version information.

methods.name: proc_read_wanmib
methods.description: Reads WAN MIB statistics.

methods.name: proc_write_wanmib
methods.description: Clears WAN MIB statistics.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version information.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates and adjusts driver parameters.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Allocates and initializes private data structures and buffers.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Frees allocated buffers and resets private data.

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes hardware configuration tables and registers.
